Introduction

This document lists
the equipment inspection, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated
by Y1 in the title block for C&D

Lead Acid 
Battery (Lead Calcium):

The first draft initiated by 
eng Metwaly Mahmoud 
el_Sayed El_Hendawy and revised by 
operation and maintenance's general director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Aziz

Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued,

The qualified maintenance staff carry the 
 suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

items:
Use standard personal safety 
 and healthy
 equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Disconnect AC supply of battery charger.
Draw out battery set on a flat clean wood plate.

Inspect out side battery containers for cracks and leakage
 of electrolyte.

Inspect contact area of inter connection, lugs, terminal
 connections, tightening and clean by plastic
 bristle brush, then coated with a thin film of No - ox - ID grease.

Clean a top of battery containers with clear water and
 neutralized acid spilt only with a solution of sodium bicarbonate baking
 soda.

Inspect and record electrolyte level, density for each
 cell ( 1.25 - 1.28 ).

Lubricate terminals for cells with a thin film of
 Vaseline.

Record voltage / cell it should be ( 2.05 0.04 ) at 1.
 25/1.28 , 77 ºf .

If cell voltage more than 0.04 below min. float voltage
 put battery under equalize charge.

Record overall voltage of battery it should be ( 2.05 x
 NO. of cell / battery if it is below put under equalizing.
Measure internal resistance per cell.
Replace defective battery.
Check battery house and dry it.
